poc_plan: Goal: Dedicated POC to validate latency, throughput, cost delta vs hosted, and rollout controls. Plan: 1) Provision small Dedicated pool (2-4 GPUs). 2) Canary: route 5% traffic to Dedicated model variant 'llama-2-13b-q4m-ded' for 48 hours, monitor p95 latency, error rate, token cost. 3) Evaluate quality vs hosted baseline on 2 prompt sets (search rerank, support chat) using Redwood Optimize eval hooks. 4) Fallback routing: primary route to Dedicated in us-east-1; if capacity or errors exceed thresholds, automatically route to hosted API model variant 'llama-2-7b-q4f' in eu-west-1 as cross-region fallback. 5) Rollback criteria: sustained error rate >2x baseline for 30m or p95 latency increase >20% for 1h or regression in QA eval score >5 points. 6) Post-POC: decision matrix for Dedicated sizing and commit level.
technical_requirements: Latency target: p95 <150ms for reranking calls, <300ms for multi-turn chat flows. Throughput: baseline 200 RPS with burst to 500. Token budgets: avg 120 tokens/query. Need prefix cache for embeddings reuse. Support for 4-bit quantized variants and KV cache warm-up API. VPC peering + customer KMS required.
pricing_notes: Requested 12-mo reserved and burst pricing scenarios. Interested in blended price if commit >= $75k ARR. Wants line items: GPU unit price, request unit price, egress, and Optimize credits. Finance: need break-even analysis vs hosted in first 6 months.
stakeholder_quotes:
Product lead: 'We need deterministic latency during product demos — can't have wild tail latency.'
Head of Infra: 'If dedicated reduces our token bill by 30% while keeping quality, we can justify commit.'
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: region quota/GPUs not available — mitigation: offer alternate region (us-west) and staggered capacity. Risk: security sign-off delay — mitigation: present SOC2 + KMS integration diagram and schedule architecture review with security on 2026-03-12.
decision_criteria: 1) Meet latency SLOs at target throughput. 2) <=20% incremental cost per useful token vs hosted (including infra). 3) No unacceptable security gaps (KMS + audit logs). 4) Clear rollback and routing controls for production cutover.
notes_short: Evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated. POC date: mid-March. Canary + fallback + rollback plan required. Budget under review.
